source_items.content_summary: Inclined-plane projectile relations are visible on the formula/practice surface.
Practice requires slope intersection, projection geometry and normal-impact reasoning.

required_concepts.title: Point and direction conditions share one impact time

valid_when: s lies along a straight plane at angle beta
impact velocity is perpendicular to the plane

source_gaps.description: The supplied scan has formula/practice evidence but no detailed inclined-plane theory section.

forbidden_inventions: Do not pretend a missing source theory section exists.
Do not add unverified source quantities.

solution_skeleton.title: Intersect
solution_skeleton.move: Set projectile and plane y-values equal.

solution_skeleton.title: Convert
solution_skeleton.move: Reject x=0 and convert x to along-plane distance.

hint_ladder.prompt: Put both paths in one x-y frame.

verification_checks: Reject the launch root and check distance geometry.

questions.prompt_summary: Time-known horizontal projection to along-plane distance.

solution_skeleton.title: Horizontal move
solution_skeleton.move: Use the stated time to find x.

hint_ladder.prompt: The stated time gives horizontal displacement first.

verification_checks: Along-plane distance should be at least the horizontal projection magnitude.

questions.prompt_summary: Normal impact with point and velocity-direction constraints.

solution_skeleton.title: Point condition
solution_skeleton.move: Require the projectile to lie on the plane.

solution_skeleton.title: Direction condition
solution_skeleton.move: Require the velocity to be normal to the plane at the same time.

hint_ladder.prompt: Normal means perpendicular to the incline, not vertical.
Draw tangent and normal at impact.
Write v_y/v_x=-cot(beta) together with the point condition.

verification_checks: Both impact constraints must use the same time.
